project_type: Expo SDK 54 managed React Native app (prebuild workflow) for Android; part of the 4astore-v2 monorepo alongside a Node/Express api-node and a Vite/React web storefront
build_system: Expo prebuild + Gradle. app.config.ts is the source of truth for native config; custom config-plugins live in mobile/plugins/*.js. newArchEnabled is true. Release signing uses the original keystore via plugins/withReleaseSigning.js. No NDK (plugins/withNoNdk.js).
test_framework: node:test via a custom loader. Run with `npm test` (node --test over src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts, loader at src/__tests__/register.mjs). No RN component/integration test harness.
build_command: npm run typecheck  (tsc --noEmit). Native binary: npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean then npm run build:aab / npm run build:apk (Gradle).
test_command: npm test  (node test suite); npm run typecheck for type safety; npx expo config --json to validate app config + plugins.
verification_instructions: From 4astore-v2/mobile: 1) npm install  2) npm run typecheck (must pass)  3) npm test (must pass)  4) npx expo config --json (config resolves, plugin listed, android.versionCode == 21). The Google button itself can only be exercised on a dev/release build, NOT Expo Go — note this; do not attempt to run it in-agent.
snapshot_or_generated_files: expo prebuild generates mobile/android/*; google-services.json is copied to mobile/android/app/google-services.json during prebuild. These are produced by the build, not hand-edited. null hand-authored generated files.
environment_constraints: The native library cannot run in Expo Go — requires a development/release build. Do NOT run a native Android build in-agent (needs JDK 17 + Android SDK + keystore passwords via env). Verification is typecheck + node tests + expo config only. google-services.json currently has an EMPTY oauth_client array — owner must re-download after registering SHA-1s; this is an owner action, not a code change.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md or .kiro/steering present. Follow existing code conventions: bilingual Hindi/English user-facing toasts, showToast from src/store/ui, apiError from src/api for error messages, graceful 'setup pending' fallback when a client id is empty. Work on branch main. Scope is 4astore-v2/mobile only, plus a verify-only read of 4astore-v2/web. Do NOT change the api-node server.
key_patterns: login.tsx uses socialLogin(idToken) from src/store/auth.ts (zustand) which POSTs /users/social-login and sets the session exactly like login(). Client IDs flow app.config.ts extra -> src/config.ts (GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID). Empty web id -> 'Google login setup pending' toast. Config plugins are registered as strings or [name, opts] tuples in the plugins array of app.config.ts.
relevant_files: 4astore-v2/mobile/app.config.ts (add config plugin, bump VERSION_CODE 20->21, keep googleServicesFile + extra client ids)
4astore-v2/mobile/app/login.tsx (rewrite Google handler; remove expo-auth-session Google wiring)
4astore-v2/mobile/google-services.json (oauth_client is EMPTY — owner re-download; study only)
4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/users.ts (/social-login accepts WEB+ANDROID audience — DO NOT CHANGE, reference)
4astore-v2/web/src/pages/Login.tsx (GIS flow — VERIFY ONLY, config-gated by VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)
directory_structure: 4astore-v2/mobile: app/ (expo-router screens incl. login.tsx), src/ (config.ts, api.ts, store/auth.ts, store/ui.ts, components/, __tests__/), plugins/ (custom config-plugins), assets/, app.config.ts, package.json, google-services.json. 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/users.ts (auth endpoints). 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/Login.tsx (web storefront login).

library_facts.name: @react-native-google-signin/google-signin
library_facts.compatibility_evidence: npm latest 16.1.5; peerDependencies expo '>=52.0.40' (project is ~54.0.37), react '*', react-native '*' (project RN 0.81.5, react 19.1.0) — all satisfied. New architecture supported. Expo config plugin shipped for the managed prebuild workflow.
library_facts.config_plugin: Firebase variant (project has google-services.json): add bare string '@react-native-google-signin/google-signin' to app.config.ts plugins (NO iosUrlScheme needed — Android-only). googleServicesFile already wired in app.config.ts.
library_facts.signin_api: import { GoogleSignin, isSuccessResponse, statusCodes }. GoogleSignin.configure({ webClientId }) once; await GoogleSignin.hasPlayServices({ showPlayServicesUpdateDialog: true }); const res = await GoogleSignin.signIn(); if (isSuccessResponse(res)) use res.data.idToken. webClientId (the WEB client id) is REQUIRED to populate idToken. statusCodes.SIGN_IN_CANCELLED => silent no-op.
